description.value: Genji is a Japanese restaurant located in the Parkgate shopping area of North Vancouver, steps from the Mount Seymour Parkway corridor that serves as a gateway to North Shore trails. The restaurant recently underwent renovations to offer a bright, clean dine-in atmosphere. Its proximity to Mount Seymour Provincial Park and regional cycling routes makes it a natural rest stop for cyclists coming off the mountain.

address.value: 3650 Mount Seymour Parkway, Unit 153, North Vancouver, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at genji-parkgate.ca confirms the business is open and operating at #153-3650 Mt Seymour Pkwy, North Vancouver, which matches the OSM address fields. The website provides a phone number — (604) 980-6886 — absent from OSM tags, and includes an 'Order Online' function indicating takeout is available. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, washrooms, device charging) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM tags contain no phone number; (604) 980-6886 sourced from website only.
OSM opening_hours tag appears to conflict with the hours listed on the website — OSM record may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible Japanese restaurant with a confirmed website and address; a useful dining option for touring cyclists near Mount Seymour.
